label: Unattributed website author, Necessary…: If an angel lacking parts were to begin to exist, it…

interpretation: This is a counterfactual question, not an assertion that an angel exists, that a partless angel could begin, or that the contemplated cause actually exists at a world. The affirmative report continues to P1D3; negative escapes and uncertainty goes to P1B2. This premise occurs only on the P1D affirmative/uncertain detour, not on every successful A10 route. Partlessness is not identified with a Lean Composite, IsSimple or component predicate. The shared cause title means a prior condition capable of explaining or partly explaining an event/change, not formal C’s actual concrete existential contributor. No actual respondent/session answer or philosophical truth is established.
